posts.title: Free Wallet Pattern
posts.description: I just recently made a compact Euro wallet pattern. The YouTube video is finally up, and there are links for the pattern there. If you are interested in leatherwork like me, you will appreciate the ease at which this wallet is made. You will of course need tools and thread, needles, and more. posts.title: New Bambu A1 3d printer
posts.description: I finally got a 3d printer. I tried making a centering jig for a leather belt. It printed perfectly. But when I assembled it, the snaps to join the jig broke. What? One hour of printing and a big failure. I should have read the comments. PLA (the plastic thread) that I was using was not suggested. They recommended ABS plastic, which is stronger. posts.title: Hotel Style Keyfob
posts.description: I spent a lot of time making this pattern. Hard to believe.
